auditMethod: Inspected primary reader/include implementations and every GSF_XML_IN_NODE/_FULL registration. Inventory retains literal macro arguments, includes second registrations and macro templates; these are source capabilities, not differential passes. All inspected files match verified archive. No native XLSX case executed for this audit. Color modifier macro registrations and rich-text/color macro use sites separately recorded so macro-expanded handlers are not omitted. Inventory counts are source declarations, not deduplicated or expanded node counts.

probe.rule: Successful gsf_infile_zip_new and existence of xl/workbook.xml; does not inspect XML, MIME, content types or root relationships.
probe.openRule: Open root transitional officeDocument relationship by type; absence emits No workbook stream found. Optional sharedStrings, theme, styles parsed before workbook; workbook end reads sheets; docprops last.
probe.xlsbReaderEvidence: None. Suffix listing and TODO do not imply binary workbook reader. Probe requires workbook.xml, not workbook.bin.
probe.strictNamespaceEvidence: No http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml spreadsheet or relationship namespace registrations found.

featureAudit.finding: Workbook properties, sheet order/name/visibility and worksheet relationships; all workbook declarations inventoried below.
Shared/inline text plus font-run markup; phonetic properties and several decorations recognized without handlers.
Fonts/fills/borders/XFs/DXFs/alignment/protection/number formats and theme colors; many theme format/effect nodes are structural or ignored.
date1904 drives workbook date convention; date values remain numeric serials plus formats. Cell type d absent from enum.
Normal/shared/array formulas, cached values, formula parser with XLSX conventions. Empty v is empty indicator queued for recalc. Formula and value coexist; array master assigns cached cell value.
Workbook/sheet scoped names, delayed name resolution and external workbook metadata; not arbitrary network workbook fetching by importer.
dimension ignored (NULL/NULL). Row/column size/visibility/outline/styles; merge ranges, panes and selection handlers.
Comments via worksheet relationship. Hyperlinks internal locations or relationships, unknown type warning. Display attribute import deliberately disabled.

Source standard filters begin/items implementation is disabled or no-op despite registrations. Custom filter replaces preceding single condition; customFilters and attr ignored. Top10 has an implemented handler; dynamicFilter whole body is #if 0 and does nothing. Color/icon filters ignored. No tablePart/tableParts reader registration or table relationship parser found. tableStyles collection exists but tableStyle itself ignored.

Standard and extension validation handlers; conditional rules/formulas/DXF support. colorScale/dataBar/iconSet declarations ignored; source TODO lists missing condition types. Unhandled conditional rule types emit Ignoring unhandled conditional format of type warnings (xlsx-read.c:2874); ignored child declarations do not imply silent rule handling.
Complete drawing/chart/VML handler registrations below. Native constructs sheet objects and goffice graphs; registrations alone do not establish complete visual fidelity.
Margins/setup/odd headers and footers/page breaks and page setup properties. printOptions itself ignored. Even/first header/footer registrations absent.
Pivot caches/records/fields/groups and table parsing are separate DTDs. ext with uri silently skips uninterpretable subtree unless xlsxext debug; missing uri warns. uri warning compiled out.

Sheet protection and style protection parsed. protectedRanges ignored. OLE object handler empty due #if 0. No VBA reader or encryption handler found in XLSX source. Encryption is not ZIP OOXML and does not pass XLSX ZIP probe; encrypted-container auto-detection may involve other importer and remains unmeasured.

unknownPartHandling.unreferencedParts: Importer follows known relationships rather than enumerating/loading every ZIP entry. No lossless preservation claim.
unknownPartHandling.unknownXml: Generic libgsf XML unknown-node diagnostics apply outside explicitly silenced ext blocks; exact stderr/ordering delegated to captured dependency profile and unmeasured here.
unknownPartHandling.corruptXml: xlsx_parse_stream reports named part is corrupt on parse failure; callers frequently continue rather than promoting every warning to fatal error.
unknownPartHandling.extensionWarning: Encountered uninterpretable "ext" extension with missing namespace

securityAudit.relationships: Native uses libgsf gsf_open_pkg_open_rel/by_type/by_id; traversal/target canonicalization behavior is dependency-owned and not measured in this audit.
securityAudit.entities: Libgsf/libxml2 parser-owned behavior; no native entity attack cases run. Product must enforce bounded XML parsing independently.
securityAudit.zipBombs: No per-import entry-count/inflation ratio/total expanded bytes policy found in XLSX reader; archive enforcement in libgsf dependency is unmeasured. Product bounds are required and may deliberately differ from native.
securityAudit.externalTargets: Hyperlink relationships expose targets as metadata. External-link relationship path records workbook reference data; no XLSX reader native networking fallback shown.
securityAudit.ownership: Native reference-counts streams, strings, expression trees and styles; JavaScript requires copied or otherwise owned byte input/output and existing realm/budget invariants. Not established by source enumeration.

remainingMeasurements: Native namespace variants including beta/Microsoft/strict wrong namespace cases
Exact unknown-element stderr and ext debug profile
coverageClaim: Handler inventory complete for inspected primary files; all runtime/native outcomes above remain unmeasured unless separately captured in implementation evidence. Unsupported and unmeasured cases are not passes.
